## Problem / Motivation

What problem does this feature solve? Who is affected and how often?

## Proposed Solution

A clear description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative approaches you've thought about and why you ruled them out.

## Additional Context

Screenshots, mockups, links to similar implementations, or any other context.
